# Lazarus Visual Mapper / Sculptural Impasto

**Scope:** activate only when the creative director explicitly selects Sculptural Impasto as the visual family (01 / Surrealist Digital Editorial), or explicitly requests an oil-impasto mapping study. **Do not apply to the other six visual families** or assume every client's portfolio should be surreal.

## Mandatory precedence

Read the real client sources and existing **AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, docs/WORKFLOW.md, Typography, Tone of Voice, Anti-Generic and Mobile Visual Integrity** documents first. This optional skill provides a **visual implementation mapping only**; it does not replace the seven client-specific concept directions, three same-copy typography specimens, source evidence record, design-contract schema or release gates.

## Read the new mapping layer

1. visual-directions/01-sculptural-impasto/VISUAL_DNA.md
2. visual-directions/01-sculptural-impasto/COMPOSITION_MAPPING.md
3. visual-directions/01-sculptural-impasto/LIGHTING_DEPTH_MAP.md
4. visual-directions/01-sculptural-impasto/SECTION_GRAMMAR.md
5. visual-directions/01-sculptural-impasto/RESPONSIVE_MAPPING.md
6. visual-directions/01-sculptural-impasto/VISUAL_QA.md
7. visual-directions/01-sculptural-impasto/mapping-data.json
8. visual-lab/sculptural-impasto/ (reference implementation, **not client-ready**)

## Mapping procedure

- State the one impossible material relationship and why this direction serves the user's **actual** reading job.
- Identify the painting's primary focal mass, quiet area, natural light, pigment-relief light and approximate front/middle/far depth. These are painting observations, not generated 3D measurements.
- Use the same actual client words to compare 3 alternative painting-to-information compositions **within the selected client-specific structural direction**; record the winner and tradeoff.
- Place important live text and functional controls in independent semantic areas **outside the painting**. One art scene is **one whole raster**, no SVG scene construction, layered cutouts, artificial CSS light, or 3D parallax.
- For mobile, preserve the core impossible relationship. Recompose a whole phone painting if needed; never pile pieces onto the desktop scene.
- Check independent human visual critique at desktop and mobile plus the existing mandatory Design OS release gates.

## Never claim

- Low-resolution 200×133 staging thumbnails are final painting masters (the lab currently has such previews).
- A generated impasto rendering proves real oil paint physical thickness or light measurements.
- An invented fictional artwork is verified client project evidence.
- CI green alone means the visual direction is artistically original or production ready.

If client evidence, authorized artwork or a readable section map is missing, **do not force the impasto aesthetic**. Keep the original Design OS workflow; document the rejected mapping and a more suitable evidence-first alternative.
